newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FEYENOORD'S LARSSON SET FOR CELTIC.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD'S LARSSON SET FOR CELTIC.

text.p: Swedish striker Henrik Larsson is set to join Scotland's Celtic but the three-year deal has been delayed by a legal wrangle involving his Dutch club Feyenoord.

The Scotsman newspaper reported on Tuesday that Feyenoord's decision to ask the Dutch soccer authorities to investigate what they call an illegal approach for the 25-year-old player had stalled proceedings by at least a day.
The Swedish TT news agency said on Monday that the dreadlocked attacker would take a medical examination on Tuesday before signing with the Glasgow side.
Celtic refused to comment on the reports.
Larsson is at odds with Feyenoord over his contract, which still has two years to run. He is due to appear before a Rotterdam tribunal on Wednesday.
